name: Get Deal
description: Get a single deal from HubSpot by its id, with a default set of deal properties. Add **Additional properties to retrieve** to include more (use **Get Properties** for `deals`). Example: Object ID `123`, Additional properties `["amount", "dealstage"]`. Returns the deal record. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/deals#endpoint?spec=GET-/crm/v3/objects/deals/{dealId})
